---
name: Feature request
about: Propose an improvement to a warehouse or investigation workflow
title: '[Feature] '
---

## Problem and workflow

What are you trying to accomplish, and what limitation gets in the way?

## Proposed behavior

Describe the change and how a user would interact with it.

## Acceptance criteria

What observable result would show that the feature works?

## Alternatives

Describe existing approaches or smaller changes you considered.

## Project contracts

Explain any effect on deterministic generation, schemas, source immutability, sandbox provenance, restricted ground truth, or statistical claim strength.

## Additional context

Use synthetic examples only. Include relevant documentation or issue links.
